description: This file defines data structures, enums, macros, and external function declarations for an infinite precision math package, including rational and number types, constants, and utility macros. It serves as a header for the ratpak library used for high-precision calculations.

classes.name: NUMBER
classes.description: A structure representing a high-precision number with a sign, digit count, exponent, and mantissa array.

classes.name: RAT
classes.description: A structure representing a rational number as a pair of NUMBER pointers (numerator and denominator).

methods.name: _createrat
methods.description: Creates and returns a new rational number structure.

methods.name: _destroyrat
methods.description: Destroys and frees a rational number structure.

methods.name: _createnum
methods.description: Creates and returns a new number structure with specified size.

methods.name: _destroynum
methods.description: Destroys and frees a number structure.

methods.name: mulrat
methods.description: Multiplies two rational numbers.

methods.name: addrat
methods.description: Adds two rational numbers.

methods.name: addnum
methods.description: Adds two number structures.

methods.name: mulnumx
methods.description: Multiplies a number structure by a scalar.

methods.name: mulnum
methods.description: Multiplies a number structure by a scalar.

methods.name: divnum
methods.description: Divides one number structure by another.

methods.name: divnumx
methods.description: Divides a number structure by a scalar.

methods.name: powrat
methods.description: Raises a rational number to a power.

methods.name: rat_equ
methods.description: Checks if two rational numbers are equal.

methods.name: rat_gt
methods.description: Checks if one rational number is greater than another.

methods.name: SetDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Sets the decimal separator character.

methods.name: ChangeConstants
methods.description: Updates internal constants based on radix and precision.

methods.name: NumberToString
methods.description: Converts a NUMBER to its string representation.

methods.name: RatToString
methods.description: Converts a PRAT to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToNumber
methods.description: Parses a string into a NUMBER.

methods.name: StringToRat
methods.description: Parses strings into a PRAT.
